Task titles can be renamed with trimming and validation. The update stays scoped to its project and preserves completion state; archived projects reject changes and disable the rename controls.

Verified with `node --check`, `git diff --check`, and an API smoke check covering health, rename, completion, blank-title rejection, and archived-project rejection. The working tree is clean.
